Tut.1_Desc: Welcome to RagnaController! This tutorial will help you get started.
Tut_1_Desc: Before you start, make sure to select your Ragnarok Online executable in the settings. The 'Focus Lock' feature ensures your controller only works when the game window is active, protecting you from accidental clicks in Windows.
Tut_2_Desc: Tired of missing tiny items? When you open your inventory, use the D-D-pad to snap the cursor perfectly from slot to slot. Premi 'A' to double-click and equip items instantly.
Tut_3_Desc: Casting Storm Gust has never been easier. Tieni down your skill button (e.g., L1+A). The targeting circle appears. Aim with the right stick. Simply RELEASE the button to cast the spell!
Tut_4_Desc: Having trouble clicking on a fast-moving Poring? Just tilt the Destra Stick slightly towards the monster and click R3. The engine will fire a micro-spiral click, guaranteeing a hit on the hitbox.
Tut_5_Desc: Need complex combos? Registra your key presses, then open the Visual Timeline Modificaor. You can drag and drop the delays perfectly to match the server's lag and your character's ASPD.
